meta.name: deepwork-tracker
meta.description: Track deep work sessions locally (start/stop/status) and generate a GitHub-contribution-graph style minutes-per-day heatmap for sharing (e.g., via Telegram). Use when the user says things like “start deep work”, “stop deep work”, “am I in a session?”, “show my deep work graph”, or asks to review deep work history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 记录专注时段并生成热力图分享
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想用热力图追踪并分享每日深度工作时间
copy.tagline_en: Track deep work sessions and generate a heatmap for sharing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to track and share your daily deep work minutes with a heatmap

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以记录深度工作会话的开始、结束和状态，并生成类似 GitHub 贡献图的每日分钟数热力图，用于分享（如通过 Telegram）。
howto.when: 当用户说出“开始深度工作”、“停止深度工作”、“我在会话中吗？”、“显示我的深度工作图”或要求查看深度工作历史时触发。

say.text: 开始深度工作，目标60分钟。

say.note: Claude 会结束当前会话并报告持续时间。

say.text: 显示我最近7天的深度工作图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can record start, stop, and status of deep work sessions, and generate a GitHub-contribution-graph style minutes-per-day heatmap for sharing (e.g., via Telegram).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says things like "start deep work", "stop deep work", "am I in a session?", "show my deep work graph", or asks to review deep work history.

say_en.text: Start deep work with a 60-minute target.
say_en.note: Claude will start a 60-minute session and attempt to start a macOS Clock timer.
Claude will end the current session and report the duration.

say_en.text: Show my deep work graph for the last 7 days.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a Telegram-formatted report and send it to Alex.
